drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Counsel,

Attached is our revised draft. It reflects a $650,000 annual base salary and, upon termination without Cause, 24 months of base salary, a pro rata target bonus, and continued health-benefit coverage, subject to execution and non-revocation of a customary release. We have deleted the non-compete and included tailored confidentiality and non-solicitation protections instead.

Please let us know if you would like to discuss any of these revisions.

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Company shall pay the Executive an annual base salary of $650,000, payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholdings. The Executive shall also be eligible to participate in the Company’s benefit plans, subject to the terms of those plans as in effect from time to time.
edits.name: Compensation

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, the Executive shall receive (a) severance equal to 24 months of the Executive’s base salary at the rate in effect immediately before termination, payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices; (b) a pro rata portion of the Executive’s target annual bonus for the year of termination, based on the number of days elapsed in that year through the termination date, payable when bonuses for that year are paid to other senior executives; and (c) continued health-benefit coverage for 24 months following termination, subject to the Executive’s execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims and applicable plan terms. The Executive shall execute and not revoke the release within the period specified by the Company, and any payments or benefits subject to the release shall commence only after it becomes effective.
edits.name: Severance

edits.text: 4. CONFIDENTIALITY AND NON-SOLICITATION. The Executive shall not use or disclose the Company’s trade secrets or other confidential information except as necessary to perform duties for the Company or as authorized in writing by the Company. This obligation does not apply to information that becomes publicly available through no breach by the Executive, or to disclosures required by law (subject to any legally permissible notice to the Company). The Executive shall not, during employment and for 12 months following termination, directly solicit for employment any employee of the Company with whom the Executive had material business contact during the 12 months before termination, or knowingly solicit any customer or actively pursued prospective customer with whom the Executive had material business contact during that period to cease or materially reduce doing business with the Company. General solicitations not directed at such employees or customers, and responses to unsolicited inquiries, are not prohibited. Nothing in this Agreement restricts the Executive from engaging in any lawful business or occupation.
edits.name: Confidentiality and Non-Solicitation
